svg.aria-label: Two auth boundaries in an MCP deployment. Between the AI agent and the MCP server sits agent-to-server identity, which the roadmap covers with DPoP, workload identity federation and token exchange. Between the MCP server and enterprise data sources like Salesforce, SQL Server, an on-premises database and a REST API sits server-to-source credentials (OAuth tokens, service accounts, API keys), which the roadmap doesn’t cover, so it stays per connector.
svg.text: gap. Credentials to each data source
